main_measure.name: mean short-direction 5-bar unusual move (return minus drift) on grid cases with forecast < 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and larger-half minus smaller-half > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 cases on at least 30 distinct days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The main t is between -2 and 2.
reading: Choppy profile read as regime 'unknown'; cases are grid bars (0, 5, 10, ... of each window) with forecast < 0 and a full 5-bar forward return inside the window; drift is each coin's mean 5-bar grid return over all its windows; the clustered t uses day sums of deviations with a G/(G-1) correction; the larger half is |forecast| above the median, the smaller half at or below it.
